The stepper belongs to its field, the colour row matches the palette row, and every button carries a glyph.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **The countdown's arrows are inside the field again, with no ground of their own.** Beside it as two filled squares they turned one control into three objects standing in a row, and they re-imported the exact property that made the browser's own spinner wrong: the complaint was never "there are arrows", it was that they arrive on their own dark background and crowd the value.
- **The accent row and the palette row are the same object now:** eight circles and a reset. The separate picker button is gone; every swatch opens the picker seeded with its own colour, which is how the palette row two lines below has always worked. Choosing a preset still costs one click, because the popover applies live on open and is simply left standing in case you want to nudge it. The "presets" caption went too: eight colour circles labelled "Accent" do not need a second word saying they are colours.
- **Send and Cancel are the same height**, 36, the same as every icon badge in the family. They were `display: block` with padding and no height, so each was as tall as its own text, which is invisible until two of them share a row.
- **Switching to the Collector tab no longer resizes the window.** Both panes share a minimum height and the drop field takes whatever is left over, so the dropzone adapts instead of the window jumping. Its two buttons are accent-filled: `secondary` was inherited from when they sat under a Send button that outranked them, and in their own tab there is nothing left for them to be secondary to.
- **Every button carries a glyph.** The design language has said so under "Icon glyphs" all along; this window was the surface not following it. Label and glyph are set together, so they cannot drift apart.
